description: This file defines a class 'SlugifyParameterTransformer' that implements the 'IOutboundParameterTransformer' interface to transform URL parameters into a slugified, lowercase hyphen-separated string.

classes.name: SlugifyParameterTransformer
classes.description: A class that transforms route parameters into URL-friendly slugs by inserting hyphens between camelCase words and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: TransformOutbound
methods.description: Transforms an object into a slugified string suitable for URL usage.
